scope_and_prior_art: This is an independent short reconstruction, not a new-result claim: Sang-Jun Park, arXiv:2602.09860v1, https://arxiv.org/html/2602.09860v1 , Theorem 3.4 and Corollary 3.6 already give that every 2-positive Sp(4)-covariant map is decomposable. The proof below uses only four exact rank-two probes and explicit positive/co-positive vertex decompositions for the displayed family; it does not import the source's classification proof. The symplectic-invariant state result is Corollary 4.3 and its locally equivalent companion Theorem 4.4, and likewise is not claimed as new.
theorem: Every 2-block-positive Hermitian W in span_R{I_16,P,F_J}, including arbitrary positive rescalings and local-unitary conjugates, is decomposable W=A+B^Gamma with A,B>=0. Thus it has nonnegative expectation on every 4x4 PPT state. The same holds after arbitrary local filtering/congruence and finite nonnegative sums of such witnesses. These particular routes cannot supply a 2-block-positive, PPT-negative target witness; this does not address general noncovariant witnesses.
definitions: J=[[0,I2],[-I2,0]] is the real 4x4 skew unitary, F=sum_{ij}|ij><ji| is swap, F_J=(I tensor J)F(I tensor J^*) and P=|omega><omega| with |omega>=(1/2)sum_{i=0}^3|ii>. Then F_J^2=I, F_J P=-P, and P is rank one. P_+=(I+F_J)/2 and P_-=(I-F_J)/2 are orthogonal projectors with ranks 10,6; P<=P_-.
normalization: If a 2-block-positive Hermitian W has trace zero, each product expectation is zero because every local product basis has a nonnegative sum equal to zero; product-polarization gives W=0. Otherwise trace W>0 and positive rescaling puts it in the unique trace-one form C(p,q)=(1-p-q)I/16+pP+qF_J/4 for real p,q.
four_necessary_rank_two_tests: Use the four unnormalized Schmidt-rank-two vectors u1=|01>+|32>, u2=|00>+|22>, u3=|00>+|11>, u4=|01>-|32>. Exact evaluation of 8<u_i|C(p,q)|u_i> gives, respectively, 1-p-5q, 1+7p-5q, 1+7p-q, 1-p+3q. Thus 2-block-positivity implies these four expressions are nonnegative.
polygon_and_vertex_proof: The four halfplanes have exactly the quadrilateral with vertices (1,0),(0,1/5),(-1/7,0),(-1/5,-2/5). At the first vertex C=P>=0. At (0,1/5), C=P_+/10>=0. At (-1/5,-2/5), C=(P_--P)/5>=0. At (-1/7,0), C^Gamma=(2I-F)/28>=0, since F has eigenvalues +/-1. Every point in the polygon is a convex combination of these four and hence is decomposable and 2-block-positive. Therefore the four necessary inequalities are also sufficient and the exact 2-block-positive parameter region is this polygon.
filter_extension: If W=A+B^Gamma with A,B>=0, then (X tensor Y)W(X tensor Y)^* is again decomposable: its co-positive summand is [ (X tensor conjugate(Y)) B (X tensor conjugate(Y))^* ]^Gamma. Nonnegative sums preserve decomposability. For every PPT rho, Tr(W rho)=Tr(A rho)+Tr(B rho^Gamma)>=0.

exact_verification.result: Integer/Fraction arithmetic checked each of the four vectors has rank exactly2, the 4 polynomial expectation triples [1,-1,-5],[1,7,-5],[1,7,-1],[1,-1,3], F_J^2=I and F_J P=-P, both symplectic projector identities, all 256 entries of the four vertex matrix identities, projector ranks 10 and 5, and the four claimed vertices satisfy all inequalities. The first checker run had a float-division comparison in the last vertex assertion; this was corrected to Fraction before the successful recorded run. No computer check of the open unrestricted conjecture was attempted.

limits: Only this symplectic family, its local-congruence images and positive sums are covered. Decomposable here is not a global characterization of all 2-positive maps on M4; neither PPT-SN<=2 in general nor existence of SN>=3 follows. The Park source precedes this reconstruction; no literature novelty clearance or independent peer review is asserted.
